items.title: The Rise of Agentic Attacks: What They Look Like, and Where They're Headed
items.summary: AI agents are changing how attackers operate. Explore real-world cases of agentic attacks, learn how to identify their fingerprints, and discover what they mean for the future of cybersecurity.
items.creator: Avigayil Mechtinger
